Build each report, to know that it can be made

Source: R/check_spec.R
tfl_check_build.Rd

The step after tfl_check_spec()'s reading: each report's data read, its ARD made, its table, listing or figure object made – all a program does but writing the RTF – in the study folder. A report that cannot be made gives an error row, part "build", with the message the build stopped on; one that can gives no row. The person's bar for OK (2026-10-30): the report's object can be made. A few seconds a report; the AI's drafts apart (options(tflspec.outputs_dir = )) are read as tfl_check_spec() reads them.

Usage

tfl_check_build(study, output_id = NULL)

Arguments

study

A study read with tfl_read_study_spec(), or its folder.

output_id

The reports to check; NULL for every report.

Value

A data frame as tfl_check_spec()'s (output_id, part, item, level, message): the reports that could not be built. Attributes ids (the reports built or tried) and kinds.

See also

tfl_check_spec() (build = TRUE does both), tfl_run_output()
